baseline: 2f636de frozen UI/desktop; same current core and fixture in both variants
method: Three alternating fresh desktop pairs. Five post-diagnostic-renderer-GC samples per phase, medians within then across processes. No other tests or benchmarks run concurrently. Fingerprints checked before/after. Optional heap snapshot disabled in measured runs.
scope: Six actual Git indexes of 20,000 paths: 19,999 tracked paths absent from worktree plus a real 300-function TypeScript file. This profiles the filename/derived graph and outline workload, not rendering 20,000 physical files. Post-GC retained heap and non-atomic Linux process-tree PSS/private pages, not normal peak RAM, VRAM or general speed.

processTree.scope: Linux process-tree sample, not atomic. PSS apportions shared pages; summed RSS double-counts sharing. Hugetlb is separate. Detached/reparented helpers, external model runtimes and display-server/GPU-driver allocations outside these processes are excluded. No forced GC.
